title: Red master: chg culprit, chg revert armed to auto-merge with a reland issue, and chg flaky

story.as_a: session whose merge turned master red
story.i_want_to: have the merge that broke master found, reverted by a PR that merges itself once green, and handed back to me as a reland issue, while a flaky test gets an issue instead of a revert
story.so_that: a red master is repaired in one CI cycle without anyone watching it, and nobody's green change is reverted for a flake

rationale: Today a red master run fails its job and nothing else happens until a person notices; deploy simply does not run (.github/workflows/ci.yml:1716-1720). chg already does the whole repair: chg culprit reruns failing tests to split out flakes and bisects the merges since a good commit (chg/docs/verify.md:24-34), chg revert opens a labelled revert PR, arms auto-merge, files a reland issue and comments on the culprit's PR, idempotent on the culprit (verify.md:35-42), and chg flaky keeps one issue per flaky test (verify.md:43). verify.md:49-77 gives the trunk workflow; this story wires it into US-53.1's workflow with loopctl's credentials.

acceptance_criteria.description: verify-master.yml gains job hunt, run only when the triggering CI run's conclusion is 'failure' and its event is 'push', on [self-hosted, fleet-ci], timeout-minutes 120, concurrency group verify-master-hunt with cancel-in-progress false, permissions contents: write, issues: write, pull-requests: write.

.github/scripts/verify-master-hunt.sh <red_sha> runs `chg verify --sha <red_sha> --no-static --no-push --failures-out failing.txt`, so the hunt never moves verified/master, and passes failing.txt's ids to `chg culprit <good> <red_sha> --tests failing.txt`, where <good> is the sha of refs/heads/verified/master read from origin.

When failing.txt is empty (the red came from a job chg's suite does not run: lint, dialyzer, retrieval eval, scale, journeys) the script runs no culprit search and opens or comments on one issue labelled master-red whose body carries an HTML-comment marker with the text master-red:<red_sha> (chg revert's own marker shape), the CI run URL and the line `chg found no failing test to search with; a person decides what to revert.`
Every id in culprit.json's flaky list is passed to `chg flaky --tests flaky.txt --run-id <CI run id> --label flaky`, and a flaky test alone never leads to a revert.

When culprit.json names a culprit, the script runs `chg revert <culprit> --run-id <CI run id> --tests real.txt --label auto-revert --fix-label reland` with real.txt = culprit.json's failing list, pushing and opening the PR with secret CHG_REVERT_TOKEN so that the revert PR's own CI runs.

When CHG_REVERT_TOKEN is unset the script runs culprit and flaky as usual, does not call chg revert, and files the master-red issue of AC-53.3.3 naming the culprit sha with the line `::error::CHG_REVERT_TOKEN is not set: no revert PR was opened for <culprit>; add the secret (docs/runbooks/chg-flow.md)`.
When good is missing (no verified/master yet) or chg culprit exits 2, the script files the master-red issue with chg's reason and exits 1; it never guesses a culprit.

test_cases.name: guard: hunt's condition, runner, timeout, concurrency and permissions (ExUnit over the parsed workflow)
expected_results: group verify-master-hunt, cancel-in-progress false; timeout-minutes 120; permissions exactly contents/issues/pull-requests write
hunt and advance can never both run for one CI run: their conditions are disjoint on conclusion

test_cases.name: script: a real failure is found, reverted and handed back (stub chg, gh, git in tmp_dir)
preconditions: @tag :tmp_dir; stub git ls-remote answering verified/master = G; stub chg whose verify writes `test/a_test.exs:3` to --failures-out and exits 1, whose culprit prints {"culprit":"C","failing":["test/a_test.exs:3"],"flaky":[]}, and which logs every argv with the GH_TOKEN it saw; CHG_REVERT_TOKEN=tok
expected_results: chg calls in order: verify --sha R --no-static --no-push --failures-out failing.txt; culprit G R --tests failing.txt; revert C --run-id <id> --tests real.txt --label auto-revert --fix-label reland
no chg flaky call; no git push by the script itself

test_cases.name: script: a flaky-only red files flaky issues and reverts nothing
expected_results: one chg flaky call with flaky.txt holding test/b_test.exs:9 and --label flaky

test_cases.name: script: no failing test, no good commit, or no culprit verdict files one master-red issue
preconditions: stub gh logging issue list/create/comment and answering an existing marked issue on the second call
steps: run with chg verify writing an empty failures file
run the same red sha again
run with ls-remote answering no verified/master
expected_results: first run creates one master-red issue carrying `an HTML-comment marker master-red:R` and the exact person-decides line; the second run comments on it and creates none
the no-good and exit-2 runs exit 1, run no revert, and the issue body carries chg's reason

test_cases.name: script: without the revert token the culprit is named but nothing is pushed

technical_notes: Commands and outputs: chg verify --no-static/--no-push/--failures-out (chg/docs/verify.md:9-17; an empty failures file after a static failure at :13), chg culprit (:24-34, output fields culprit/failing/flaky and exit 2 when the search could not run), chg revert (:35-42, branch auto-revert/<sha12>, auto-merge armed at chg/cli/src/revert.rs:121-122, labels created on demand at :295), chg flaky (:43). Default labels chg/cli/src/main.rs:253,277,279.

Why --no-static: the static jobs already judged R in CI; with --no-static and --no-push the verify run is only the source of failing ids. A suite that passes here (CI's Test failed only on journeys, or a flake) yields an empty file, which AC-53.3.3 hands to a person.

Token: a PR or push made with GITHUB_TOKEN starts no CI run, so a revert PR armed for auto-merge would never merge (HCB .github/workflows/verify-master.yml:516-517 opens and arms its revert PR with SYNC_PAT for this reason). loopctl's CI triggers on push only (ci.yml:4-12), so here the revert branch's push must use the PAT too, not only the PR. chg revert pushes with the checkout's credential and opens with gh (revert.rs:288, :113), so the hunt checks out with token: CHG_REVERT_TOKEN and sets GH_TOKEN to it for the revert step only. The secret does not exist (gh secret list, 2026-11-20): an owner question.

Auto-merge is allowed on the repo (gh api repos/mkreyman/loopctl: allow_auto_merge true, 2026-11-20). The revert PR merges on master's required checks (Lint, Test, Security, Dialyzer, Retrieval Eval, Pgbouncer e2e, Scale Tests, MCP Server Gate), which run on its push like any branch.

chg culprit runs probes in a throwaway worktree with its own test database (verify.md:34); on fleet-ci it needs the CI Postgres the Test job uses (ci.yml:339-546). Its MIX_TEST_PARTITION follows the Test job's per-run naming so two hunts never share a database.

The reland issue and the culprit-PR comment are how the culprit's session hears of it (verify.md:39-40). docs/runbooks/chg-flow.md gains a `Red master` section: the three outcomes, the labels, and how to add CHG_REVERT_TOKEN (fine-grained, this repo, contents/pull-requests/issues write).
non_goals: Quarantining a flaky test out of the gating set (chg design.md:182): chg flaky files the issue only.
Finding a culprit for a red static, dialyzer, retrieval or scale job: a person decides (AC-53.3.3).
Counting reverts and red time: US-53.7.

failure_modes.partition: AC-53.3.7: a culprit search that cannot reach GitHub or run a probe exits 2 and the hunt files the master-red issue instead of reverting on a guess.
failure_modes.state: AC-53.3.5: the revert branch, PR and reland issue live on GitHub keyed by chg's culprit marker; the master-red issue by its master-red:<sha> marker (AC-53.3.3).
failure_modes.retry: AC-53.3.3: a re-run of the hunt comments on the existing master-red issue, and chg revert finds its own marked branch, PR and issue and does only what is missing.
failure_modes.slow: AC-53.3.1: timeout-minutes 120 bounds the bisect, and verify-master-hunt keeps one hunt running with one pending, so a burst of red runs does not stack bisects on the pool.
failure_modes.reach: AC-53.3.2: the hunt reads good from origin's verified/master and the red sha from the CI run, so any fleet-ci slot can run it.

definition_of_done: On a scratch branch pair (a deliberately failing test merged to a throwaway copy of master, or a dry run with `chg culprit` on a known red commit), the hunt's summary shows the culprit and the auto-revert PR URL, and `gh pr view <url> --json autoMergeRequest` is non-null.
`gh issue list --label reland` shows the reland issue naming the failing test ids.
The PR body states which red case was exercised live and which only by the stub tests.
defaults: Labels auto-revert, reland, flaky (chg's defaults) and master-red.
Hunt timeout 120 minutes; chg culprit --reruns 2 (chg's default).
Without CHG_REVERT_TOKEN: name the culprit in a master-red issue, open no PR.
